categories.name: Straightforward Procurement & Invoice Clearing
categories.description: Standard, high-frequency procurement sequences with minimal activity steps and clean resolution paths ending in invoice clearing (e.g., V0001, V0002, V0005).
categories.rationale: These variants represent the backbone of the process volume, showing standard execution times and no anomalous rework or length profiles.

categories.name: Short-Cycle or Early Deletion Orders
categories.description: Short tracing lengths characterized by immediate completion or quick cancellation/deletion right after purchase order creation without full lifecycle progression (e.g., V0009, V0014, V0024).
categories.rationale: Grounded in samples that terminate early or exhibit low trace lengths representing quick aborts or simple order generation.

categories.name: Service Entry Sheet & Goods Receipt Rework
categories.description: Low duration variants characterized by repeated Service Entry Sheets and Goods Receipt recordings executed instantaneously by batch resources (e.g., V0162, V0244, V0271).
categories.rationale: Exhibits distinctive duplicate patterns of service and receipt actions completed with zero median duration.

categories.name: SRM Integration & Transfer Failures
categories.description: Complex lifecycle variants involving SRM sub-states, transfer attempts, transmission changes, and final system errors or failures (e.g., V2944, V2952, V2950).
categories.rationale: Unified by their inclusion of specialized SRM lifecycle states and failure outcomes.

categories.name: Extreme Length Process Churn
categories.description: Extremely long, highly repetitive process executions containing hundreds of cyclical invoice creations, cancellations, and goods receipts spanning multiple years or extreme trace lengths (e.g., V3680, V3305, V3102, V3074, V6776).
categories.rationale: These represent outlier extreme cases with massive trace lengths and extensive internal rework loops.
